pages.title: True or False
pages.content: A Boolean represents one of two values: `True` or `False`. Booleans are essential for making decisions in your code. Note: in Python, they must be capitalized.

pages.title: Using Booleans
pages.content: Booleans are often the result of comparisons:
pages.code:
is_sunny = True
is_raining = False

print(10 > 5)    # True
print(3 == 7)    # False
print(is_sunny)  # True

pages.title: Quick Check
pages.question: What does `5 > 3` evaluate to?
pages.explanation: 5 is greater than 3, so the expression evaluates to True.
